headline: Spain's Q2 Home Prices Rose 12.2% as Government Targets Tourist Rentals
summary: Spain's home prices rose 12.2% year-on-year in the second quarter of 2026 while labor costs rose 4.0%, prompting government crackdowns on tourist rentals.
why: Rapidly escalating housing costs relative to wage growth create severe affordability strains and provoke regulatory interventions in European real estate markets.
